text: Solar and wind power are examples of renewable energy.
options: 可以再生、不容易用完的能源
只能用一次的能源
價格非常便宜的能源
answer: 可以再生、不容易用完的能源

wrong.只能用一次的能源: renewable 有「可再生」的意思，與用完就沒有相反；太陽與風能持續存在。
wrong.價格非常便宜的能源: renewable 說的是能否再生，與價格高低無關。

why: renew 是更新、再生，renewable 表示能夠不斷補充的資源，如太陽能與風能。
tip: renewable：可再生的，如太陽能、風能。
say: Solar and wind power are examples of renewable energy.

text: Burning coal increases carbon _____ in the atmosphere.
options: emissions
admissions
emotions

wrong.admissions: admissions 是入學許可或承認，與排放氣體無關。
wrong.emotions: emotions 是情緒，只是拼字有點像，意思不符。

why: emissions 指排放物，carbon emissions 是碳排放，與氣候變遷討論有關。
say: Burning coal increases carbon emissions in the atmosphere.

prompt: 哪一句關於永續（sustainable）的敘述最正確？
options: We should use resources in a sustainable way.
We should use resources in a sustain way.
We should use resources in a sustainably way.
answer: We should use resources in a sustainable way.

wrong.We should use resources in a sustain way: sustain 是動詞，名詞 way 前面需要形容詞 sustainable。
wrong.We should use resources in a sustainably: sustainably 是副詞，不能修飾名詞 way。

why: way 是名詞，要用形容詞 sustainable 修飾。
tip: 名詞前用形容詞 sustainable，動詞後用副詞。
say: We should use resources in a sustainable way.

prompt: 環保報告中，你想說：「減少塑膠使用能保護海洋生物。」
options: Reducing plastic use can protect marine life.
Reduce plastic use can protect marine life.
Reducing plastic use can protects marine life.
answer: Reducing plastic use can protect marine life.

wrong.Reduce plastic use can protect marine li: 句子的主詞需要動名詞 Reducing，不能用原形 Reduce 直接當主詞。
wrong.Reducing plastic use can protects marine: can 後面要接原形 protect，不能加 s。

why: 動名詞 Reducing ... 當主詞，can 後面接動詞原形 protect。
tip: 動名詞當主詞，助動詞 can 後面接原形。
say: Reducing plastic use can protect marine life.

text: The factory switched to clean energy in order to _____ its environmental impact.
options: reduce
produce
introduce

wrong.produce: produce 是製造，會讓語意變成想製造環境衝擊，不合理。
wrong.introduce: introduce 是介紹或引進，與 impact（影響）搭配不通順。

why: in order to + 動詞，目的是減少環境衝擊，reduce its impact 最合理。
say: The factory switched to clean energy in order to reduce its environmental impact.

prompt: 短文中說 deforestation 對動物有害，因為什麼？
text: Deforestation destroys habitats, so many animals lose their homes.
options: 森林被砍除，動物失去棲息地
森林長得太快，動物找不到食物
天氣變冷，動物搬去城市
answer: 森林被砍除，動物失去棲息地

wrong.森林長得太快，動物找不到食物: Deforestation 是砍伐森林，不是森林長得太快。
wrong.天氣變冷，動物搬去城市: 句中沒有談到天氣變冷，原因是 habitats 被破壞。

why: deforestation 指砍伐森林，destroys habitats 就是破壞棲息地，導致動物失去家園。
tip: deforestation 砍伐森林，habitat 是棲息地。
say: Deforestation destroys habitats, so many animals lose their homes.

prompt: 哪一句比較級的用法正確？
options: Wind power is cleaner than coal.
Wind power is more clean than coal.
Wind power is cleaner as coal.
answer: Wind power is cleaner than coal.

clean 是單音節形容詞，比較級通常加 -er，不是 more clean。
比較級 cleaner 後面要用 than，不是 as。

why: 短形容詞比較級加 -er，再用 than 引出比較對象。
tip: 短形容詞 + er + than 做比較。
say: Wind power is cleaner than coal.

prompt: 同學問你為什麼要回收，你想說：「回收能減少垃圾，也能節省資源。」
options: Recycling reduces waste and saves resources.
Recycling reduce waste and save resources.
Recycle reduces waste and saves resources.
answer: Recycling reduces waste and saves resources.

wrong.Recycling reduce waste and save resource: 動名詞當主詞視為單數，動詞要用 reduces 和 saves。
wrong.Recycle reduces waste and saves resource: Recycle 是動詞，不能直接當主詞，要用 Recycling。

why: Recycling 是動名詞主詞，視為單數，後面兩個動詞都加 s，用 and 並列。
tip: 動名詞當主詞，視為單數，動詞加 s。
say: Recycling reduces waste and saves resources.

text: Many cities have introduced bike lanes _____ cut traffic and pollution.
options: to
for to
in order

wrong.for to: for 和 to 不能這樣連用，表示目的只需 to + 原形動詞。
wrong.in order: in order 後面還需要 to，直接接 cut 不完整。

why: to + 原形動詞表示目的，to cut traffic and pollution 就是為了減少交通與污染。
tip: 表示目的：to + 原形動詞。
say: Many cities have introduced bike lanes to cut traffic and pollution.

prompt: 下面這句話暗示作者的態度是什麼？
text: Although electric cars are expensive, they can save money in the long run.
options: 雖然電動車貴，但長期來說可以省錢
電動車很便宜，所以沒人買
電動車不能長期使用
answer: 雖然電動車貴，但長期來說可以省錢

wrong.電動車很便宜，所以沒人買: 句中說 expensive 是昂貴，而且沒有提到沒人買。
wrong.電動車不能長期使用: in the long run 是長期來看，句子說的是長期能省錢，不是不能使用。

why: Although 子句承認缺點，主要子句強調長期的優點，重點在後半。
tip: Although 後是讓步，主要子句才是重點。
say: Although electric cars are expensive, they can save money in the long run.

prompt: 哪一句被動語態是正確的？
options: Many trees were planted by the volunteers.
Many trees planted by the volunteers.
Many trees was planted by the volunteers.
answer: Many trees were planted by the volunteers.

缺少 be 動詞，planted 單獨會變成分詞片語，句子沒有完整動詞。
wrong.Many trees was planted by the volunteers: trees 是複數，be 動詞要用 were，不能用 was。

why: 過去式被動語態是 were/was + 過去分詞，複數主詞用 were。
tip: 被動 = be 動詞 + 過去分詞，注意單複數。
say: Many trees were planted by the volunteers.

text: If we don't act now, sea levels _____ continue to rise.
options: will
would be
did

wrong.would be: would be 後面不能直接接 continue，而且條件句現在式主句用 will。
wrong.did: did 是過去式助動詞，與 don't act now 的現在條件不一致。

why: If + 現在式，主句用 will + 原形，表示對未來的預測。
tip: If 現在式，主句用 will + 原形。
say: If we don't act now, sea levels will continue to rise.
